- **Protein powder:** Whey or plant-based supplements
- **Nuts/seeds:** Almonds, hemp seeds, chia seeds

**Breakfast:** Oatmeal with protein powder, berries, nuts
**Lunch:** Quinoa bowl with beans, vegetables, tahini
**Dinner:** Tofu/tempeh stir-fry with brown rice
**Snacks:** Greek yogurt, protein smoothies, hummus with vegetables

## Key Tips
- Eat protein at every meal (25-30g per meal)
- Time protein intake around workouts
- Stay hydrated (3+ liters daily)
- Include vitamin B12 and iron-rich foods
- Consider creatine supplementation
